title: Anonymous USAF colonel and fighter pilot's UFO encounter

tellings.quote: he had a really dramatic UFO encounter in 1980 or something like that.

plain: A US Air Force colonel and fighter pilot, never named, had a dramatic UFO encounter in about 1980, according to what he told the UFO documentary maker James Fox. Fox repeats it second-hand and gives no details beyond the rough year and how dramatic it was, saying it happened "in 1980 or something like that."
